title: Built this 3D game with AI as my only teammate.
author: SonnyGnz
selftext:
Solo dev in New Zealand. Built this 3D game with AI as my only teammate.

Greek myth roguelite — top-down, bow combat, manual aim.

· Characters: AI-generated, retargeted in Blender  
· Music: I wrote the MIDI by hand, note by note  
· The rest: Unity, and a lot of arguing with Claude

First boss: Circe. The witch who turns men into pigs.

Early days. More soon.
